extension.summary: Kodi System Toolbox - essential utilities for Kodi
Kodi系统工具箱 - 电视盒子与系统维护必备工具
extension.description: A comprehensive system toolbox for Kodi and embedded media centers (CoreELEC, LibreELEC, Android, Linux, Windows). Features include: one-click OS switching (dual-boot), network speed test, disk read/write benchmark (sequential and 4K random IOPS), network IP/gateway/DNS configuration, and Kodi log cleaner.
专为Kodi与嵌入式播放系统（CoreELEC、LibreELEC、安卓外贸盒子、Linux、Windows）打造的系统工具箱。主要功能：1. 一键切换双系统（安卓/CoreELEC/重启等）；2. 网络带宽测速；3. 存储读写测速（顺序读写与4K随机读写IOPS）；4. 系统网络配置（静态IP/DHCP、网关、DNS）；5. Kodi日志查看与一键清理；支持模块化持续扩展。
